summary: Accept the tui alias after global CLI options and use Fractal branding and command hints throughout the terminal interface.

replay.detail: No graph replay or projection changes.

compatibility.detail: The tui spelling is a clap alias of ui, including after --endpoint and for legacy binary names. Existing ui invocations remain accepted. Only terminal interface display text and documented command hints change; identifiers, paths and protocol markers are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or downtime required.
